answer: The pigment counter is kept in gale and beacon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4767 identities would post 4724 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
